doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: What makes a genius, and Donegan's own legacy
summary: Geniuses know they are; she counts herself one in all ways and expects more Dorothy Donegans to come.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: You mentioned a few of these people being geniuses. What does it take in Dorothy Donegan’s mind to be a genius?
Well, Cecil Taylor would be a genius in his way. And Ahmad Jamal. I guess geniuses, they know when they’re geniuses.
What has Dorothy Donegan brought to the musical world that was not there before and will not be there after her?
There will just be more Dorothy Donegans coming up.
